conflicts.description: Inventory sync with SAP ERP is specified as both real-time and daily batch process

version_a.text: Inventory levels must sync with SAP ERP in real time.

version_b.text: Product information must sync with SAP ERP via daily batch process.

conflicts.description: Vendor pricing control contradicts vendor product listing management — TR-008 and TR-022 imply vendors manage product information, but TR-020 prohibits vendors from setting prices, while US-016 broadly allows vendors to manage their own product listings without clarifying the pricing exclusion

version_a.text: Vendors cannot set product prices; only RetailCorp central admin controls pricing.

version_b.text: The system shall allow vendors to manage their own product listings on the platform.

conflicts.description: GDPR compliance requires data handling rules that may conflict with the constraint that all customer data must be stored on servers physically located within India, as GDPR applies to EU/NRI data subjects and may require data portability or deletion mechanisms that conflict with a strict India-only storage mandate

version_a.text: Platform must comply with GDPR regulations for NRI customer data handling.

version_b.text: All customer data must be stored on servers physically located within India.

conflicts.description: Real-time inventory sync with SAP conflicts with the business rule requiring zero-inventory products to be hidden — if real-time sync has any latency or the batch process (TR-028) is used instead, products could incorrectly appear available

version_a.text: Products must not be shown as available if inventory is zero in SAP.

version_b.text: Product information must sync with SAP ERP via daily batch process.

conflicts.description: ZestMoney partnership is assumed to be finalized before go-live, but no corresponding functional requirement exists for ZestMoney integration, while Bajaj Finance EMI is explicitly required — creating ambiguity about whether ZestMoney EMI must also be supported at launch within the 6-month constraint

version_a.text: ZestMoney partnership agreement will be finalized before platform go-live.

version_b.text: Platform must go live within 6 months maximum from project start.

conflicts.description: Central admin is stated as the sole controller of pricing, but store managers are given authority to manage returns — TR-006 implies store managers have operational authority that may conflict with centralized admin control described in TR-007 and TR-053

version_a.text: Central admin team manages products, pricing, and promotions across the platform.

version_b.text: Store managers must be able to manage product returns from their region.
